question:
Which of the following is the target of National Logistics Policy-2022?

I. To increase logistics cost.

II. To develop a data-driven decision support system.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **National Logistics Policy (NLP) 2022** was launched by the Government of India on **September 17, 2022**, to enhance logistics efficiency and reduce costs in India. 
• The policy aims to reduce logistics costs from the current **13-14% of GDP** to **8%** by the year **2030**. 
• It emphasizes the development of a **data-driven decision support system** to optimize logistics, enabling better policy formulation and real-time monitoring. 
• Statement I: "**To increase logistics cost**" is **incorrect** because the policy explicitly focuses on reducing logistics costs to improve global competitiveness.
